body.name: Known-propensity minimax separation radius
body.construction: \(\rho_\star^{\mathrm{known}\ e}(n)=\inf\{\rho>0:\exists\text{ measurable }\phi_n^{\mathrm{known}\ e}:O^n\times\mathcal E_{\alpha,L,\epsilon}\to[0,1],\ \sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}:\,V(P)=0}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}\phi_n^{\mathrm{known}\ e}(O^n,e_P)\le a_0,\ \sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}:\,V(P)\ge\rho^2}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}[1-\phi_n^{\mathrm{known}\ e}(O^n,e_P)]\le b_0\}\), with the exact propensity \(e_P(x)=P(A=1\mid X=x)\) supplied as the second input and an empty alternative supremum equal to zero.
